xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4508: Jev settings in the dashboard: route, model and timeout, plus a per-feature usage readout

plan.title: Jev settings in the dashboard: route, model and timeout, plus a per-feature usage readout
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Settings → Background AI exposes the three Jev toggles and the TypeSafe key, but jev.base_url (route), jev.model (required, no default) and jev.timeout_ms live only in ~/.overdeck/config.yaml, so switching off the limited-time jev-1.13-free model means hand-editing YAML. Nothing shows what Jev is doing: AC-review judgments go to eval-log files, turn-end labels live only in memory, and failed requests are recorded nowhere.
narratives.Proposal: Add a path-scoped config door (src/lib/jev/settings.ts, PUT/GET /api/jev/settings in a new routes/jev.ts) that writes only jev.base_url, jev.model and jev.timeout_ms, validated by a pure leaf module (src/lib/jev/settings-validation.ts), then clears the config cache and the Jev memo so the next call uses the new values. Block turning a Jev toggle on without a model, client-side in BackgroundAiSection and server-side in validateSettingsApi (off→on is an error, already-on is a grandfathered warning). Record one JSONL usage line per real Jev request (src/lib/jev/usage-log.ts, hooked in assess()), summarize it at GET /api/jev/usage, and render calls-in-24h / last call / last error under each Jev toggle. A JevSettingsPanel with route select, model field and timeout field autosaves through a useJevSettings hook. Document the UI in configuration/jev.mdx. Full detail, decisions D1–D14 and exact strings: .pan/drafts/PAN-4508.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Editing jev.api_key_ref in the UI (stays config.yaml-only; the door never writes or deletes it)
- Adding jev to ApiSettingsConfig or changing the whole-document PUT /api/settings payload shape
- Any line growth in src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts, or raising any file-size allowlist cap
- Showing turn-end labels or acceptance-criteria eval-log contents in the usage readout
- Storing SDK error message text, request state, answers, or the API key in the usage log or API responses
- Pruning or rotating ~/.overdeck/jev/usage/ files
- A live Jev connection-test button or a per-route model allowlist
- New route-scopes.ts rows (the new routes keep the default admin scope)
- Wiring jevMemoryRelevance to a caller

autoDecisions.summary: Write route/model/timeout through a dedicated path-scoped door (PUT /api/jev/settings in a new routes/jev.ts), not the whole-document PUT /api/settings.
autoDecisions.rationale: routes/settings.ts is at its file-size cap (1104/1104) and settings-api.ts has 32 lines of headroom; the whole-document save is documented as lossy (codebase map concerns.md); writeYamlConfigPreservingComments never touches jev:, so both writers coexist inside runSettingsWriteSerialized. Same pattern as PAN-4400 model presets.

autoDecisions.summary: Route select: zen writes base_url https://opencode.ai/zen, direct deletes base_url, any other existing base_url shows as read-only 'custom' and is preserved.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the two routes documented in configuration/jev.mdx and never destroys a hand-set endpoint.
The issue's Proposal names only route, model and timeout; the key slot already exists in Settings.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Toggle on' means background_ai.features.<key> === true regardless of low-cost mode; turning one on with a blank model is an error, an already-on toggle with a blank model is a warning on unrelated saves.
autoDecisions.rationale: Low-cost mode can be switched off at any time, so an on toggle must already have a model; grandfathering avoids 400s on every unrelated autosave for operators already in that state.

autoDecisions.summary: Usage is a file-backed JSONL log (~/.overdeck/jev/usage/<UTC date>.jsonl), not an in-memory counter.
autoDecisions.rationale: Acceptance-criteria review runs inside the pan plan finalize CLI process, so a dashboard-only counter would miss those calls.

autoDecisions.summary: Usage rows store the closed failure reason plus HTTP status, never err.message.
autoDecisions.rationale: SDK error messages can echo response bodies; the client header promises never to log the error object.

autoDecisions.summary: After a settings write, clear the config cache and the Jev memo.
autoDecisions.rationale: The memo key includes the model but not base_url or timeout, so without a reset a route change could be answered from a result obtained on the old route.

autoDecisions.summary: Usage window: calls counted over the last 24 h; last call and last error scanned over the last 7 UTC day files.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the read bounded while still showing an older last call or error with its time.

metadata.sizeJustification: Not needed: ~22 files across 5 subsystems, under the 25-file / 6-subsystem limits.

items.title: Pure Jev settings validation leaf module

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/jev/settings-validation.ts with type-only imports (PRD WI-1). Export JEV_ZEN_BASE_URL='https://opencode.ai/zen', JEV_FEATURE_KEYS, type JevRoute ('zen'|'direct'|'custom'), interface JevSettingsInput {route, model, timeoutMs}, routeForBaseUrl(baseUrl) (absent→direct; Zen URL with or without one trailing slash→zen; else custom), validateJevSettingsInput(input: unknown, current: {baseUrl?, features?}) returning {ok:true,value} with the model trimmed or {ok:false, errors} collecting all of: 'route must be zen, direct, or custom'; 'route custom keeps an existing custom base_url; none is set' (custom when current base_url is not custom); 'jev.model is required while a Jev feature is on' (blank model while any JEV_FEATURE_KEYS entry is true in current.features); 'jev.timeout_ms must be an integer between 1 and 30000'. Export jevToggleProblems(next, current|undefined): for each Jev key with next[key]===true and blank current.model → error 'Set a Jev model in Settings → Background AI before turning on <key>' when current.features[key]!==true, else warning '<key> is on but jev.model is not set; Jev makes no requests until a model is set'. current undefined means all toggles off and model blank. Add the unit test file.

items.title: Given base_url values undefined, 'https://opencode.ai/zen', 'https://opencode.ai/zen/' and 'https://example.test/jev', routeForBaseUrl returns direct, zen, zen and custom respectively

Given a blank model and current.features.jevTurnEndAssessment true, validateJevSettingsInput returns ok:false with the exact error 'jev.model is required while a Jev feature is on'; given timeoutMs 0, 30001 or 1.5 it returns 'jev.timeout_ms must be an integer between 1 and 30000'

Given route 'custom' while the current base_url is absent, validateJevSettingsInput rejects with 'route custom keeps an existing custom base_url; none is set'; a valid input returns ok:true with the model trimmed

jevToggleProblems returns an error when a Jev toggle goes off→on with a blank current model, returns a warning (no error) when that toggle is already on in current, and returns no problems when current is undefined and next has no Jev toggle on
Path-scoped jev: block read/write door with cache and memo reset

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/jev/settings.ts per PRD WI-2. Import getGlobalConfigPath/clearConfigCache/loadConfigSync from ../config-yaml/load.js (not ../config-yaml.js), runSettingsWriteSerialized from ../settings-api.js, writeFileAtomic from ../model-presets/state.js, resetJevMemo from ./memo.js, defaults from ../config-yaml/jev.js, and WI-1 exports. Export JevSettingsValidationError (errors: string[]), jevSettingsFromDocument(doc) → JevSettingsView {configured, route, baseUrl, model, timeoutMs (default 2000), apiKeyRef (default TYPESAFE_API_KEY)}, readJevSettings(deps) (ENOENT → defaults with configured:false), and saveJevSettings(input, deps) which runs inside runSettingsWriteSerialized: re-read and parse config.yaml, clearConfigCache() then read features from loadConfigSync().config.backgroundAi.features, validate with validateJevSettingsInput, throw JevSettingsValidationError without writing on failure; on success zen→setIn(['jev','base_url'], JEV_ZEN_BASE_URL), direct→deleteIn(['jev','base_url']), custom→untouched; non-blank model→setIn, blank→deleteIn(['jev','model']); setIn(['jev','timeout_ms']); never touch api_key_ref; write via writeFileAtomic(path, doc.toString({lineWidth:120}), 0o600); then clearConfigCache(), resetJevMemo(), return the view. Use fs/promises only. Tests use a real mkdtemp config path injected through deps.

items.title: Given a config.yaml with a Zen jev block, api_key_ref MY_KEY, a comment and an unrelated top-level key, saveJevSettings({route:'direct', model:'jev-1.13.0', timeoutMs:1500}) writes a file with no jev.base_url, model jev-1.13.0, timeout_ms 1500, and preserves api_key_ref, the comment and the unrelated key

Given a config.yaml with no jev block, saveJevSettings({route:'zen', model:'jev-1.13-free', timeoutMs:2000}) creates the block and readJevSettings then returns configured:true, route:'zen', model:'jev-1.13-free', timeoutMs:2000
Given an invalid input (timeoutMs 0), saveJevSettings rejects with JevSettingsValidationError and the config file bytes are identical before and after
After a successful save, loadConfigSync().config.jev returns the new model and timeoutMs without a process restart, and resetJevMemo was called once

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-4: create src/lib/jev/usage-log.ts (eval-log.ts style, `import type` only for JevFeature/JevFailureReason) exporting JevUsageRow {ts, feature, outcome:'answered'|'failed', reason?, status?, model, durationMs}, resolveJevUsageLogPath(home, date) → <home>/jev/usage/<UTC YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl, appendJevUsage(row, {home?}) (mkdir+appendFile, swallows every error), and readJevUsageSummary({home?, now?}) → {hours:24, features:{jevTurnEndAssessment, jevAcceptanceCriteriaReview, jevMemoryRelevance: {calls24h, lastCallAt, lastError:{at, reason, status?}|null}}} reading the last 7 UTC day files with fs/promises, skipping missing files and unparsable lines. In src/lib/jev/client.ts inside the withJevSlot callback: record startedAt before systemOne; after recordBackgroundAiCost `void appendJevUsage({... outcome:'answered', model: servedModel, durationMs})`; in catch compute reason=classifyJevError(err), `void appendJevUsage({... outcome:'failed', reason, status when err instanceof APIError, model: resolved.model, durationMs})`, then return failed(reason, err). Never record on memo hits, unavailable results, or the config-load failure path. Never store err.message, state, answers or the key. Update the client module header.

items.title: Given rows at now-1h, now-23h and now-25h for jevTurnEndAssessment, readJevUsageSummary returns calls24h 2 and lastCallAt equal to the now-1h timestamp; given only a row 3 days old it returns calls24h 0 and lastCallAt set to that row

Create hooks/useJevSettings.ts: useQuery ['jev-settings'] (GET /api/jev/settings), useQuery ['jev-usage'] (GET /api/jev/usage, non-OK → null, refetchInterval 60_000), latest-wins save(next, {debounce}) debounced by AUTOSAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS from ./useAutosavePipeline, setQueryData on 200, serverError from a 400 body's error; return {settings, usage, save, serverError}.
